description: MacArthur Bridge → Wooded Canals (Sylvan Canal) → Blue Heron Lagoon. Visual quality review, not a racing route or guided autopilot.

stops.name: MacArthur Bridge
stops.focus: Weathered arch concrete, steel rails, embankment stone and sun-facing structure

stops.name: Wooded Canals · Sylvan Canal
stops.focus: Full canopy, exposed roots, mossy ground, calm shaded water and clear trail margins

stops.name: Blue Heron Lagoon
stops.focus: Restored wetland edge, reeds, limestone riprap, lagoon mud, fallen wood and inlet footbridge
